map.pH = -log₁₀[H⁺]，本工具由 pH 求氢离子浓度，反之亦然。: pH = -log₁₀[H⁺]; this tool converts pH into hydrogen ion concentration and vice versa.
map.pH 与氢离子浓度换算器: pH and Hydrogen Ion Concentration Converter
map.对数理解：每降 1 个 pH，[H⁺] 升 10 倍。: Logarithmic intuition: every 1-unit drop in pH raises [H⁺] tenfold.
map.报告换算：实验 pH 转浓度列检验报告。: Reporting: convert measured pH into concentration for inspection reports.

map.pH 负数是啥？: What does a negative pH mean?
map.强酸高浓度 [H⁺]>1 时 pH<0，数学上可能，但常规表 0–14。: When [H⁺] > 1 in concentrated strong acid, pH < 0 is mathematically possible, although tables usually run 0–14.
map.和 pOH 关系？: How does it relate to pOH?
map.pH+pOH=14（25°C），可联算。: pH + pOH = 14 (25 °C), so the two can be converted into each other.
